spans.s: उद्भट (I) a. (f. टा) 1. Excellent, पदे पदे संति भटा रणोद्भटाः Na.i.132; 2. exalted, magnanimous.
उद्भट (II) m. 1. A fan for winnowing corn; 2. a tortoise.
उद्भट (I) a. (f. टा) 1. Excellent, पदे पदे संति भटा रणोद्भटाः Na.i.132; 2. exalted, magnanimous.
उद्भव m. 1. Creation, generation, production, दिलीपसूनुर्मणिराकरोद्भवः R.iii.18, Rt.i.8, Am.
, M.i.93, Yaj.iii.80; 2. source; 3. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
उद्भाव m. 1. Production, generation; 2. magnanimity.
उद्भावन n. 1. Thinking, thinking over; 2. production, generation; 3. inattention, neglect.
उद्भास m. Radiance, splendour, K.S.v.78.
उद्भासुर a. (f. रा) Radiant, shining, splendid, Am.
उद्भासुर a. (f. रा) Radiant, shining, splendid, Am.
उद्भिद् m. 1. A shoot or sprout; 2. a plant; 3. a fountain.
उद्भिद्-ज (I) a. sprouting, germinating (as vegetation).
उद्भिद्-ज (II) m. A plant, M.i.46.
उद्भिद्-विद्या f. botany.
उद्भिद a. (f. दा) See उद्भिज्ज.
उद्भिद a. (f. दा) See उद्भिज्ज.
उद्भूत a. (f. ता) 1. Born, generated, produced; 2. capable of being perceived by the senses, as a गुण (in Vaiśeṣika phil.).
उद्भूत a. (f. ता) 1. Born, generated, produced; 2. capable of being perceived by the senses, as a गुण (in Vaiśeṣika phil.).
उद्भूति f. 1. Generation, production; 2. elevation, increase, prosperity, वरः शंभुरलं ह्येष त्वत्कुलोद्भूतये विधिः K.S.vi.82.
उद्भेद m. 1. Breaking through or out, i.e. becoming visible, setting in, beginning to grow, तं यौवनोद्भेदविशेषकांतम् R.v.38, K.S.viii.24; 2. horripilation; 3. a spring of water.
उद्भेदन n. 1. Breaking through or out, i.e. becoming visible, setting in, beginning to grow, तं यौवनोद्भेदविशेषकांतम् R.v.38, K.S.viii.24; 2. horripilation; 3. a spring of water.
उद्भ्रम m. 1. Whirling, flourishing; 2. regret.
उद्भ्रमण n. 1. Wandering about; 2. rising.
